notes: manufactum.com (EN storefront) reached via direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/block (matches prior Home-Decor pass). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. No dedicated Dog/Cat/Pets top-level nav section exists; 'Pet Supplies' sits three levels deep under Household > Home Improvement. No pet food/consumables or medical/veterinary categories found on site (none to flag). ABSENCE PROOF: full sitemap_pages.xml text-scanned for pet-adjacent keywords (see above) plus a targeted -cNNNN category-URL grep for dog/cat/pet/animal/tier prefixes - only the one category surfaced.
